The fix anchors trust on the comment **author** (the gh-828 `readVerdictRecords` doctrine), with `actor` stamped additionally for audit; both are covered below and in the thread replies.

## Approach

- **Thread 11/15 (BLOCKING — the parked marker writer).** `parkSteps` now posts the `state:"parked"` machine marker (`transplantMarkerComment`) beside the human park comment. One writer cures both symptoms: `_parkResetDecision` re-arms on a moved head (AC4 live again) and `_orphanStep` GCs a parked-marker orphan (the per-tick duplicate-park spam loop is gone). The wiring now pins `ctx.usedSha` from `sequenceHeadSha(seq)` — the merge step's own sha — so a park-reset close comment names the NEW head, not the stale recorded sha.
- **Thread 12/16 (terminal `transplanted` marker).** Both shared tails (`transplantBodySteps`, `_resumeTailSteps`) end with a `transplanted_marker` step after `close_pr`. The op is rendered by the wiring (`guestApplyStep`) from the runtime ctx — the created PR number and merge sha only exist after the steps ran — so the terminal marker carries `transplant: <newPrNumber>`, `merged: <mergedSha>`, `actor`. A reopened source now reads `noop / already-transplanted` (pinned by a wiring-faithful replay: the transport's own posted comments fed back through `parseTransplantMarker`).
- **Thread 13/17 (marker authentication).** `parseTransplantMarker(comments, trustedLogins)` now fails closed: no allowlist / empty allowlist / a comment with no readable author ⇒ **no marker**. Author matching mirrors `reviewVerdicts` (`user.login || author.login || author.name`, lowercased, `[bot]` stripped). The wiring passes `verdictMachineLogins(effectiveConfig)` on every probe — the action, the sweep's orphan probe, and the `completionRentry` re-entry (the sweep now threads the real list instead of `[]`). Writers stamp `actor: <first machineAuthor login>` on every marker (arm, parked, re-arm, transplanted) for audit.
- **Thread 14/18 (gate checker has zero callers).** Resolved as the reviewer's option 2: the checker is a project-side integration hook (the machine PR deliberately walks the standard validate-fresh lane with zero fork-specific code, so there is no guest dispatch site in this repo to wire). The `guest-transplant` rule description and the `guestValidationDispatchPlan` docblock now name the contract: the consuming project's validate leg fetches the dispatched workflow's job graph, calls `guestValidationDispatchPlan(jobs, smGuestTransplant.gate, workflowFile)` before dispatch, and fails the leg on `ok: false` — and states plainly that a project skipping the hook has **no gate enforcement**. The "impossible by construction" wording is now scoped to the transport property it actually covers (no fork-owned ref ever targeted).
- **Thread 19 (fa#939 hold on the E5 re-entry).** The sweep's `complete_orphan` handler now probes the source's current labels (`buildPrLabelsCommand` + `guestPrLabels`) and consults the new pure predicate `completionHold(labels, holdLabel, marker)` — the park label without our own parked marker = a human hold ⇒ the completion is skipped (branch left for a later tick); an unreadable label probe holds too (fail closed toward the freeze). Holds log `⏸️ … the source carries a human hold (fa#939)`.

{"content":"# Rework round 3 — all 9 open review threads fixed (4 findings + re-assertions + the fa#939 hold)

## Issues/Notes

- Threads 11–14 arrived as 4 findings; threads 15–18 are their verbatim re-assertions on head `ef6c959e`; thread 19 is new. All 9 now carry fixes (or, for the gate-checker contract, the reviewer-sanctioned documentation) on this head.
- Round 2's review-summary numbers in the PR description ("52 tests / 5594 passed") are stale — this head measures **92 transplant tests**, **5636 full-suite**. The description body is bot-authored; the numbers above are authoritative for this round.
- Thread 13/17 fix note: the suggested `actor` payload field alone could not secure marker trust — the marker lives on the **guest's own PR**, so any payload field (actor included) is guest-writable. The fix anchors trust on the comment **author** (the gh-828 `readVerdictRecords` doctrine), with `actor` stamped additionally for audit; both are covered below and in the thread replies.

## Approach

- **Thread 11/15 (BLOCKING — the parked marker writer).** `parkSteps` now posts the `state:"parked"` machine marker (`transplantMarkerComment`) beside the human park comment. One writer cures both symptoms: `_parkResetDecision` re-arms on a moved head (AC4 live again) and `_orphanStep` GCs a parked-marker orphan (the per-tick duplicate-park spam loop is gone). The wiring now pins `ctx.usedSha` from `sequenceHeadSha(seq)` — the merge step's own sha — so a park-reset close comment names the NEW head, not the stale recorded sha.
- **Thread 12/16 (terminal `transplanted` marker).** Both shared tails (`transplantBodySteps`, `_resumeTailSteps`) end with a `transplanted_marker` step after `close_pr`. The op is rendered by the wiring (`guestApplyStep`) from the runtime ctx — the created PR number and merge sha only exist after the steps ran — so the terminal marker carries `transplant: <newPrNumber>`, `merged: <mergedSha>`, `actor`. A reopened source now reads `noop / already-transplanted` (pinned by a wiring-faithful replay: the transport's own posted comments fed back through `parseTransplantMarker`).
- **Thread 13/17 (marker authentication).** `parseTransplantMarker(comments, trustedLogins)` now fails closed: no allowlist / empty allowlist / a comment with no readable author ⇒ **no marker**. Author matching mirrors `reviewVerdicts` (`user.login || author.login || author.name`, lowercased, `[bot]` stripped). The wiring passes `verdictMachineLogins(effectiveConfig)` on every probe — the action, the sweep's orphan probe, and the `completionRentry` re-entry (the sweep now threads the real list instead of `[]`). Writers stamp `actor: <first machineAuthor login>` on every marker (arm, parked, re-arm, transplanted) for audit.
- **Thread 14/18 (gate checker has zero callers).** Resolved as the reviewer's option 2: the checker is a project-side integration hook (the machine PR deliberately walks the standard validate-fresh lane with zero fork-specific code, so there is no guest dispatch site in this repo to wire). The `guest-transplant` rule description and the `guestValidationDispatchPlan` docblock now name the contract: the consuming project's validate leg fetches the dispatched workflow's job graph, calls `guestValidationDispatchPlan(jobs, smGuestTransplant.gate, workflowFile)` before dispatch, and fails the leg on `ok: false` — and states plainly that a project skipping the hook has **no gate enforcement**. The "impossible by construction" wording is now scoped to the transport property it actually covers (no fork-owned ref ever targeted).
- **Thread 19 (fa#939 hold on the E5 re-entry).** The sweep's `complete_orphan` handler now probes the source's current labels (`buildPrLabelsCommand` + `guestPrLabels`) and consults the new pure predicate `completionHold(labels, holdLabel, marker)` — the park label without our own parked marker = a human hold ⇒ the completion is skipped (branch left for a later tick); an unreadable label probe holds too (fail closed toward the freeze). Holds log `⏸️ … the source carries a human hold (fa#939)`.

## Files Modified

- `js/common/guestTransplant.js` — parked-marker writer in `parkSteps`; terminal `transplanted_marker` step in both tails; authenticated `parseTransplantMarker` (+ `_newestAllowedMarker`/`_authorAllowed`/`_commentAuthorLogin`/`_trustedLogin`); `sequenceHeadSha`; `completionHold`; `buildPrLabelsCommand`; `actor` stamped by all four marker writers; the gate-checker integration contract documented.
- `js/smAgent.js` — `guestMarker` authenticates via the machineAuthor allowlist; `transplantGuestPrAction` threads `actorLogin` + pins `usedSha` via `sequenceHeadSha`; the `transplanted_marker` op in `guestApplyStep`; `sweepClosedGuestBranches`/`guestSweepEntry` thread `machineLogins` and hold completions on the fa#939 predicate; the tick loop passes `verdictMachineLogins(effectiveConfig)` into the sweep.
- `js/unit-tests/test_guestTransplant.js` — +19 tests (92 total): marker auth (forged-vs-real feeds, empty/absent allowlists, author-less comments, `[bot]` normalization, E1 on the authenticated feed), the parked-marker writer + park-reset replays, the terminal-marker round-trips (fresh + resume), `sequenceHeadSha`, `completionHold`, `buildPrLabelsCommand`.
- `sm_github.json` — the `guest-transplant` rule description: the gate integration contract named, the overstated enforcement wording scoped, and the new marker behaviors documented (parked/terminal/authenticated markers, the fa#939 hold on completion).

## Test Coverage

- **Thread 12/16 (terminal `transplanted` marker).** Both shared tails (`transplantBodySteps`, `_resumeTailSteps`) end with a `transplanted_marker` step after `close_pr`. {"content":"# Rework round 3 — all 9 open review threads fixed (4 findings + re-assertions + the fa#939 hold)

## Issues/Notes

- Threads 11–14 arrived as 4 findings; threads 15–18 are their verbatim re-assertions on head `ef6c959e`; thread 19 is new. All 9 now carry fixes (or, for the gate-checker contract, the reviewer-sanctioned documentation) on this head.
- Round 2's review-summary numbers in the PR description ("52 tests / 5594 passed") are stale — this head measures **92 transplant tests**, **5636 full-suite**. The description body is bot-authored; the numbers above are authoritative for this round.
- Thread 13/17 fix note: the suggested `actor` payload field alone could not secure marker trust — the marker lives on the **guest's own PR**, so any payload field (actor included) is guest-writable. The fix anchors trust on the comment **author** (the gh-828 `readVerdictRecords` doctrine), with `actor` stamped additionally for audit; both are covered below and in the thread replies.

## Approach

- **Thread 11/15 (BLOCKING — the parked marker writer).** `parkSteps` now posts the `state:"parked"` machine marker (`transplantMarkerComment`) beside the human park comment. One writer cures both symptoms: `_parkResetDecision` re-arms on a moved head (AC4 live again) and `_orphanStep` GCs a parked-marker orphan (the per-tick duplicate-park spam loop is gone). The wiring now pins `ctx.usedSha` from `sequenceHeadSha(seq)` — the merge step's own sha — so a park-reset close comment names the NEW head, not the stale recorded sha.
- **Thread 12/16 (terminal `transplanted` marker).** Both shared tails (`transplantBodySteps`, `_resumeTailSteps`) end with a `transplanted_marker` step after `close_pr`. The op is rendered by the wiring (`guestApplyStep`) from the runtime ctx — the created PR number and merge sha only exist after the steps ran — so the terminal marker carries `transplant: <newPrNumber>`, `merged: <mergedSha>`, `actor`. A reopened source now reads `noop / already-transplanted` (pinned by a wiring-faithful replay: the transport's own posted comments fed back through `parseTransplantMarker`).
- **Thread 13/17 (marker authentication).** `parseTransplantMarker(comments, trustedLogins)` now fails closed: no allowlist / empty allowlist / a comment with no readable author ⇒ **no marker**. Author matching mirrors `reviewVerdicts` (`user.login || author.login || author.name`, lowercased, `[bot]` stripped). The wiring passes `verdictMachineLogins(effectiveConfig)` on every probe — the action, the sweep's orphan probe, and the `completionRentry` re-entry (the sweep now threads the real list instead of `[]`). Writers stamp `actor: <first machineAuthor login>` on every marker (arm, parked, re-arm, transplanted) for audit.
- **Thread 14/18 (gate checker has zero callers).** Resolved as the reviewer's option 2: the checker is a project-side integration hook (the machine PR deliberately walks the standard validate-fresh lane with zero fork-specific code, so there is no guest dispatch site in this repo to wire). The `guest-transplant` rule description and the `guestValidationDispatchPlan` docblock now name the contract: the consuming project's validate leg fetches the dispatched workflow's job graph, calls `guestValidationDispatchPlan(jobs, smGuestTransplant.gate, workflowFile)` before dispatch, and fails the leg on `ok: false` — and states plainly that a project skipping the hook has **no gate enforcement**. The "impossible by construction" wording is now scoped to the transport property it actually covers (no fork-owned ref ever targeted).
- **Thread 19 (fa#939 hold on the E5 re-entry).** The sweep's `complete_orphan` handler now probes the source's current labels (`buildPrLabelsCommand` + `guestPrLabels`) and consults the new pure predicate `completionHold(labels, holdLabel, marker)` — the park label without our own parked marker = a human hold ⇒ the completion is skipped (branch left for a later tick); an unreadable label probe holds too (fail closed toward the freeze). Holds log `⏸️ … the source carries a human hold (fa#939)`.

## Files Modified

- `js/common/guestTransplant.js` — parked-marker writer in `parkSteps`; terminal `transplanted_marker` step in both tails; authenticated `parseTransplantMarker` (+ `_newestAllowedMarker`/`_authorAllowed`/`_commentAuthorLogin`/`_trustedLogin`); `sequenceHeadSha`; `completionHold`; `buildPrLabelsCommand`; `actor` stamped by all four marker writers; the gate-checker integration contract documented.
- `js/smAgent.js` — `guestMarker` authenticates via the machineAuthor allowlist; `transplantGuestPrAction` threads `actorLogin` + pins `usedSha` via `sequenceHeadSha`; the `transplanted_marker` op in `guestApplyStep`; `sweepClosedGuestBranches`/`guestSweepEntry` thread `machineLogins` and hold completions on the fa#939 predicate; the tick loop passes `verdictMachineLogins(effectiveConfig)` into the sweep.
- `js/unit-tests/test_guestTransplant.js` — +19 tests (92 total): marker auth (forged-vs-real feeds, empty/absent allowlists, author-less comments, `[bot]` normalization, E1 on the authenticated feed), the parked-marker writer + park-reset replays, the terminal-marker round-trips (fresh + resume), `sequenceHeadSha`, `completionHold`, `buildPrLabelsCommand`.
- `sm_github.json` — the `guest-transplant` rule description: the gate integration contract named, the overstated enforcement wording scoped, and the new marker behaviors documented (parked/terminal/authenticated markers, the fa#939 hold on completion).

## Test Coverage

- TDD: the 19 round-3 tests were written first and ran RED (73 passed / 19 failed) before any production change; GREEN after the fixes (92/92).
- `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_guestTransplant.json` → **92 passed, 0 failed** (exit 0).
- `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` → **5636 passed, 0 failed** (exit 0).

{"content":"# Rework round 3 — all 9 open review threads fixed (4 findings + re-assertions + the fa#939 hold)

## Issues/Notes

- Threads 11–14 arrived as 4 findings; threads 15–18 are their verbatim re-assertions on head `ef6c959e`; thread 19 is new. All 9 now carry fixes (or, for the gate-checker contract, the reviewer-sanctioned documentation) on this head.
- Round 2's review-summary numbers in the PR description ("52 tests / 5594 passed") are stale — this head measures **92 transplant tests**, **5636 full-suite**. The description body is bot-authored; the numbers above are authoritative for this round.
- Thread 13/17 fix note: the suggested `actor` payload field alone could not secure marker trust — the marker lives on the **guest's own PR**, so any payload field (actor included) is guest-writable. The fix anchors trust on the comment **author** (the gh-828 `readVerdictRecords` doctrine), with `actor` stamped additionally for audit; both are covered below and in the thread replies.

## Approach

- **Thread 11/15 (BLOCKING — the parked marker writer).** `parkSteps` now posts the `state:"parked"` machine marker (`transplantMarkerComment`) beside the human park comment. One writer cures both symptoms: `_parkResetDecision` re-arms on a moved head (AC4 live again) and `_orphanStep` GCs a parked-marker orphan (the per-tick duplicate-park spam loop is gone). The wiring now pins `ctx.usedSha` from `sequenceHeadSha(seq)` — the merge step's own sha — so a park-reset close comment names the NEW head, not the stale recorded sha.
- **Thread 12/16 (terminal `transplanted` marker).** Both shared tails (`transplantBodySteps`, `_resumeTailSteps`) end with a `transplanted_marker` step after `close_pr`. The op is rendered by the wiring (`guestApplyStep`) from the runtime ctx — the created PR number and merge sha only exist after the steps ran — so the terminal marker carries `transplant: <newPrNumber>`, `merged: <mergedSha>`, `actor`. A reopened source now reads `noop / already-transplanted` (pinned by a wiring-faithful replay: the transport's own posted comments fed back through `parseTransplantMarker`).
- **Thread 13/17 (marker authentication).** `parseTransplantMarker(comments, trustedLogins)` now fails closed: no allowlist / empty allowlist / a comment with no readable author ⇒ **no marker**. Author matching mirrors `reviewVerdicts` (`user.login || author.login || author.name`, lowercased, `[bot]` stripped). The wiring passes `verdictMachineLogins(effectiveConfig)` on every probe — the action, the sweep's orphan probe, and the `completionRentry` re-entry (the sweep now threads the real list instead of `[]`). Writers stamp `actor: <first machineAuthor login>` on every marker (arm, parked, re-arm, transplanted) for audit.
- **Thread 14/18 (gate checker has zero callers).** Resolved as the reviewer's option 2: the checker is a project-side integration hook (the machine PR deliberately walks the standard validate-fresh lane with zero fork-specific code, so there is no guest dispatch site in this repo to wire). The `guest-transplant` rule description and the `guestValidationDispatchPlan` docblock now name the contract: the consuming project's validate leg fetches the dispatched workflow's job graph, calls `guestValidationDispatchPlan(jobs, smGuestTransplant.gate, workflowFile)` before dispatch, and fails the leg on `ok: false` — and states plainly that a project skipping the hook has **no gate enforcement**. The "impossible by construction" wording is now scoped to the transport property it actually covers (no fork-owned ref ever targeted).
- **Thread 19 (fa#939 hold on the E5 re-entry).** The sweep's `complete_orphan` handler now probes the source's current labels (`buildPrLabelsCommand` + `guestPrLabels`) and consults the new pure predicate `completionHold(labels, holdLabel, marker)` — the park label without our own parked marker = a human hold ⇒ the completion is skipped (branch left for a later tick); an unreadable label probe holds too (fail closed toward the freeze). Holds log `⏸️ … the source carries a human hold (fa#939)`.

## Files Modified

- `js/common/guestTransplant.js` — parked-marker writer in `parkSteps`; terminal `transplanted_marker` step in both tails; authenticated `parseTransplantMarker` (+ `_newestAllowedMarker`/`_authorAllowed`/`_commentAuthorLogin`/`_trustedLogin`); `sequenceHeadSha`; `completionHold`; `buildPrLabelsCommand`; `actor` stamped by all four marker writers; the gate-checker integration contract documented.
- `js/smAgent.js` — `guestMarker` authenticates via the machineAuthor allowlist; `transplantGuestPrAction` threads `actorLogin` + pins `usedSha` via `sequenceHeadSha`; the `transplanted_marker` op in `guestApplyStep`; `sweepClosedGuestBranches`/`guestSweepEntry` thread `machineLogins` and hold completions on the fa#939 predicate; the tick loop passes `verdictMachineLogins(effectiveConfig)` into the sweep.
- `js/unit-tests/test_guestTransplant.js` — +19 tests (92 total): marker auth (forged-vs-real feeds, empty/absent allowlists, author-less comments, `[bot]` normalization, E1 on the authenticated feed), the parked-marker writer + park-reset replays, the terminal-marker round-trips (fresh + resume), `sequenceHeadSha`, `completionHold`, `buildPrLabelsCommand`.
- `sm_github.json` — the `guest-transplant` rule description: the gate integration contract named, the overstated enforcement wording scoped, and the new marker behaviors documented (parked/terminal/authenticated markers, the fa#939 hold on completion).

## Test Coverage

Everything is verified and committed. Final summary:

## Rework round 3 complete — all 9 open threads on pr-1142 fixed

**The four findings (threads 11–14) + their re-assertions (15–18) + the new suggestion (19):**

- **T11/15 (BLOCKING)** — `parkSteps` now writes the `state:"parked"` machine marker beside the human comment: AC4's auto re-arm is live, parked-marker orphans GC instead of re-completing (the per-tick duplicate-park spam loop is dead), and `ctx.usedSha` is pinned from `sequenceHeadSha(seq)` so the park-reset close comment names the new head.
- **T12/16** — both shared tails end with a terminal `transplanted_marker` step (wiring-rendered from runtime ctx): a reopened, already-transplanted source is now a `noop / already-transplanted` — pinned by a wiring-faithful round-trip replay.
- **T13/17 (security)** — markers are machineAuthor-authenticated at parse time (fail closed on missing/empty allowlist or unreadable author), with trust anchored on the comment **author** (the gh-828 doctrine — a payload `actor` field alone would be guest-writable); the wiring passes the real allowlist everywhere including the sweep; writers stamp `actor` for audit.
- **T14/18** — resolved as the reviewer's sanctioned option 2: the gate-checker integration contract is now documented (rule description + docblock name `guestValidationDispatchPlan` as the project-side hook and state plainly that skipping it means no gate enforcement); the overstated "impossible by construction" wording is scoped to the transport property.
- **T19** — the E5 completion re-entry now probes the source's labels and holds on the fa#939 freeze (`completionHold` pure predicate, fail-closed on unreadable probes).

**TDD held:** 19 tests written first, RED (73/19), then GREEN (92/0). The CRAP battery caught 4 over-threshold regressions my own edits introduced (`parseTransplantMarker` 12, `_parkResetDecision` 9, `transplantSequence` 9, test helper 10) — fixed by splitting the parser and dropping redundant `||` terms, then re-verified on a fresh instrument+coverage run.
